summary: User deposited funds into Yepbit and participated in scheduled copy paste trading and recruitment incentives while receiving initial withdrawals. Withdrawals were later frozen after a promotional event and users were subsequently encouraged to deposit additional funds into a new platform called AXIOM to obtain compensation.
user_mistake: Deposited funds into a recruitment driven trading platform
prevention: Avoid platforms that require recruitment to increase returns / Do not deposit additional funds into another platform to recover frozen balances
